title: Someone Else's Ledger
description: A customer's invoice is their own business, not another customer's to browse. Confirm ownership is enforced on a single-invoice lookup.
successCondition: Customer A books a shipment and creates an invoice for it. Customer B (a different logged-in customer account) calls GET /api/billing/invoices/:id with that invoice's id and receives 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN.
hints: Register two separate customer accounts to get two independent, non-overlapping sessions.
dispatcher and admin roles are explicitly allowed to see any invoice — this test specifically needs both accounts to be role customer to exercise the ownership check.
